subject: Error in Installing Amber 20 on GPU

messages.author: Suchetana Gupta
messages.body:
Hi Amber Users
We tried installing Amber 20 on our GPU machine. While the serial
installation was smooth, we could not install it on GPU. I have attached
the error messages that I obtained while trying to install Amber20 on
CUDA.
We have CUDA 9.0 on Quadro card.
We followed the installation instructions on the Amber 20 manual (Section
20.6.5, Pg. 406).
Our serial installation gave no errors and it passed all tests too. We have
not attempted installation in parallel.
Please guide us in solving this issue.
Thanks
Suchetana Gupta
IACS, Kolkata

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Jun 29, 2020, Suchetana Gupta wrote:
>We tried installing Amber 20 on our GPU machine. While the serial
>installation was smooth, we could not install it on GPU.
Did you modify the run_cmake script to set -DCUDA=TRUE? Your build
report from cmake indicates that CUDA is OFF, so it never even tried to
build pmemd.cuda.
All the tests then fail with simple messages like this:
/home/sks/Desktop/SUCHETANA/amber20/bin/pmemd.cuda_DPFP: Command not found.
This is consistent with the hypothesis that you never asked to build
pmemd.cuda. But there may be something else happening that I'm not
seeing -- better to post your log file as a text file, rather than
converting it to Microsoft Word....
....dac

messages.body:
On Tue, Jun 30, 2020, Suchetana Gupta wrote:
>Yes, we did modify -DCUDA=TRUE in the CMake script.
You need to study the cmake output to look for why the build report says
that CUDA is OFF. The test output just says what it said before, that
you never build pmemd.cuda.
Have you set your CUDA_HOME environment variable? Is the cuda SDK in a
standard place, like /usr/local/cuda?
...dac
